text:
maria_cs: Hi team — onboarding with Nimbus (customer) hitting steady 429s during initial SDK warmup. Root cause unclear, they say it's during the 'init' path when we do token preflight + telemetry. Attached logs below.

liam_engineer: Can you paste the log snippet? is it preflight or generation?

maria_cs: Preflight. Here's the chunk: ```
HTTP 429 response from /v1/sessions/init
x-rate-limit-retry-after: 12
user-agent: Nimbus/1.2.0 SDK-js
```

devon_platform: Hmm. If retry-after is 12 that means upstream classified them into a short window. Are they opening many parallel http/2 streams?

jordan_onboard: They said their CI spins up 40 parallel workers hitting init at once for warmup. We recommended splay but they didn't implement yet.

liam_engineer: 40 concurrent inits will cause preflight stampede. Suggest two mitigations: 1) recommend ephemeral token reuse + conn pool (keep-alive) 2) stagger by random jitter on startup.

maria_cs: I asked them to add a 0-1000ms jitter; they replied they can't change CI easily. Any server-side fallback we can enable?

devon_platform: We can enable ephemeral fanout mitigation: turn on 'init-coalesce' for their tenant for 24h (groups their preflight within 5s window). Need approval from infra, pinging @ratebot for switch.

ratebot: infra-flag-request: enable init_coalesce for tenant nimbus-acc-42? Reply with Y to approve.

maria_cs: Y — please enable.

ratebot: flag enabled. Observability: starting 60s roll.

liam_engineer: Also noticed their SDK sends telemetry header `x-client-heartbeat: true` on init, which pushes them into a higher priority bucket; recommend removing telemetry on preflight or send as batched later.

jordan_onboard: I'll follow up with Nimbus and ask for header change and conn pooling.

maria_cs: Nimbus confirmed they'll reduce parallelism in CI to 8 and add jitter. We'll monitor. Thanks all :thumbsup:

liam_engineer: After coalesce + CI changes we should see 429s drop. I'll watch the per-tenant rate chart and post back in 15m.

maria_cs: Logged action items: (1) flag enabled (devon), (2) customer to reduce concurrency + jitter (jordan), (3) liam monitor and close.

jordan_onboard: note for renewal risk: flagged as medium until we see 24h stability, capture in account health.

maria_cs: adding to renewal dashboard.
